data.name: AlHaij
data.gender_notes: AlHaij is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Al-Hajj means 'The Pilgrim'. It is a name given to Muslims who have completed the Hajj pilgrimage to Mecca. The name AlHaij carries the meaning “The Pilgrim” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose AlHaij usually hope their child will grow to embody the pilgrim and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Al-Hajj represents faith, dedication, and spiritual growth. It is a name for those who have embarked on the journey of a lifetime, seeking to draw closer to Allah and connect with their fellow Muslims.
data.etymology: AlHaij belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Pilgrim.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of AlHaij total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: الحيج
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من الحج يدل على الزيارة والطواف
in_arabic.long_meaning: الحيج هو اسم مشتق من كلمة الحج، وهي تعبر عن الزيارة والطواف حول الكعبة المشرفة في مكة المكرمة. يشير الاسم إلى الأهمية الروحية للحج في الإسلام والارتباط بالشعائر الدينية.

in_urdu.name: الہائج
in_urdu.meaning: مشتق از حج، حج کی ادائیگی، کعبہ کی زیارت
in_urdu.long_meaning: الہائج ایک نام ہے جو حج سے ماخوذ ہے۔ حج اسلام کا ایک اہم ستون ہے جس میں مسلمان کعبہ کی زیارت کرتے ہیں اور روحانی تجدید کا تجربہ کرتے ہیں۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقالید اور روحانی سفر کی اہمیت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अलहाइज
in_hindi.meaning: हज से व्युत्पन्न, काबा की यात्रा, आध्यात्मिक यात्रा
in_hindi.long_meaning: अलहाइज एक नाम है जो हज से लिया गया है। हज इस्लाम का एक महत्वपूर्ण हिस्सा है जहां मुसलमान काबा की यात्रा करते हैं और आध्यात्मिक नवीनीकरण का अनुभव करते हैं। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपराओं और आध्यात्मिक यात्रा के महत्व को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: الحيج
in_pashto.meaning: د حج څخه مشتق شوی، کعبې ته د سفر معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: الحيج د حج څخه مشتق شوی نوم دی. حج د اسلام يو مهم رکن دی چي مسلمانان کعبې ته سفر کوي او روحاني تجديد تجربه کوي. دا نوم د اسلامي دودونو او روحاني سفر د اهميت ښودنه کوي.

in_english.name: AlHaij
in_english.meaning: Derived from Hajj, pilgrimage to Kaaba
in_english.long_meaning: AlHaij is a name derived from the Arabic word 'Hajj', which refers to the pilgrimage to the Kaaba in Mecca. The Hajj is a significant ritual in Islam, symbolizing spiritual renewal and devotion. The name AlHaij embodies the spiritual significance of the pilgrimage and the connection to Islamic traditions.

data.cultural_impact: The name Al-Hajj holds a significant cultural status not just within Islamic communities but across the world as it symbolizes the completion of an important religious journey. The Hajj pilgrimage is one of the Five Pillars of Islam and is regarded as a mandatory act for every able-bodied Muslim once in their lifetime, if resources and health permit. it signifies unity and brotherhood among all Muslims across different nationalities and socioeconomic backgrounds as they undertake this common religious obligation. Examples of prominent figures with this name include Al-Hajj Malik Obaydi, the first sub-Saharan African President of Senegal, and Al-Hajj Khalifah, the first Turkish foreign minister after the establishment of the Republic of Turkey.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Al-Hajj carries profound spiritual significance as it is a reminder of an individual's intentional commitment to their faith and reminds them of the importance of leaving materialistic pursuits behind to connect spiritually with their Creator and fellow Muslims. The completion of the Hajj pilgrimage is a humbling and transformative experience for many as they renew their faith, engage in worship, and connect with the religious history and traditions of Islam. This spiritual growth and renewal continues long after the physical journey and instills a deep sense of gratitude and devotion to Allah.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "The Pilgrim" symbolizes Al-Hajj means 'The Pilgrim'. It is a name given to Muslims who have completed the Hajj pilgrimage to Mecca.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name AlHaij serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of the pilgrim.

historical_references.context: Al-Haij was a well-known figure in the Islamic community during the early Islamic period. He was known for his piety and generosity, and played an important role in the development of Islamic society.
